meta.policy: Every table row links to one of these URLs, each opened and read on 2026-11-12 UTC via fetch_page or web_search. Third-party blogs are not used. If a page cannot be opened, the dependent value is left blank and flagged.
meta.title: Official source registry for the Suggestions & Decision Hub

sources.label: NFL Football Operations — 2026 Official NFL Rulebook
sources.what_confirmed: Published rulebook landing page with 2026 rule-change table (6-1-3, 6-1-5, 6-1-6, 19-2) and link to downloadable PDF. Basis for settlement and overtime definitions.

sources.label: NFL Game Statistics & Information System — Guide for Statisticians (2025 edition, 38 pp.)
sources.what_confirmed: Defines how rushing, passing, receiving, sacks, fumbles and scoring are credited. Content list includes Rushing, Passing and Sacks, Fumbles, Qualifications for Individual Leaders. PDF header reads Copyright 2025 NFL, Last Modified 2025.

sources.label: NFL and Genius Sports extend strategic partnership as exclusive official data, Watch and Bet distribution partner
sources.what_confirmed: Genius Sports is the exclusive distributor of real-time official play-by-play statistics, proprietary Next Gen Stats, and the official sports-betting data feed to media and sportsbook operators globally.

sources.label: NFL Football Operations — Performance Tracking Data (Next Gen Stats) technology page
sources.what_confirmed: Describes stadium tracking: 20-30 ultra-wide band receivers, 2-3 RFID tags per player plus tags for officials, pylons and ball; location, speed, distance and acceleration sampled at 10 times per second; metrics via ML on AWS; 200+ data points per play.

sources.label: NFL.com — Official Injury Report hub
sources.what_confirmed: Weekly injury report hub listing practice participation (Did Not Participate / Limited Participation / Full Participation) and game-status designations (Questionable / Doubtful / Out). Weekly deep links follow /injuries/league/<season>/regN.

sources.label: NFL Competition Committee — Revisions to Injury Report Policy (status definitions)
sources.what_confirmed: Practice Report categories: Did Not Participate / Limited Participation / Full Participation. Game Status Report: Questionable = uncertain to play, Doubtful = unlikely to play, Out = will not play. Probable designation eliminated (retired 2016).

sources.label: NFL.com — New England Patriots official roster
sources.what_confirmed: Team roster page under /teams/<team>/roster listing all players with position, status (ACT/RES etc.), height, weight, experience and college. Same pattern verified for LA Rams roster on 2025-07-11.

sources.label: NFL.com — Los Angeles Rams official roster
sources.what_confirmed: Roster table with Player, No, Pos, Status, Height, Weight, Experience, College. Status codes ACT, RES, DEV etc.

sources.label: NFL.com — 2026 passing statistics (player-stats category)
sources.what_confirmed: Official player passing stats with yards, attempts, completions, TD, INT. Live dynamic page; e.g., Jordan Love 2,246 yards through Week 8 at prior reads.

sources.label: NFL.com — 2020 division standings
sources.what_confirmed: Completed-season standings verified against rebuilt records from committed extract: e.g., GB 13-3-0, 509 PF / 369 PA; DET 5-11-0, 377 PF / 519 PA. 32/32 match on recomputation.

sources.label: NFL.com — 2026 division standings
sources.what_confirmed: Live division standings page with W-L-T and PF/PA per team. Snapshot 2026-11-02: BUF 6-1-0 233/181, MIN 6-1-0 140/93, etc. Dynamic page moves weekly.

sources.label: NFL.com — 2026 Week 9 schedule
sources.what_confirmed: Week 9 entries include TNF Nov 5 JAX at BAL 8:15 PM ET; Madrid international game Nov 8 CIN at ATL 9:30 AM; Sunday Nov 8 slate with Broncos-Panthers, Cowboys-Colts, Jets-Chiefs, etc.; bye teams listed.

sources.label: NFL.com — 2026-27 Important Dates (Personnel (Injury) Report Policy filing deadlines)
sources.what_confirmed: Clubs must file Practice Reports by 4:00 p.m. ET on practice days and Game Status Report by 4:00 p.m. ET the day before each game; updates required on any change.

sources.label: Indianapolis Colts — Official Depth Chart
sources.what_confirmed: Depth chart table with Position rows and First/Second/Third/Fourth columns listing projected starters and backups per position, e.g., QB Daniel Jones then Anthony Richardson Sr., RB Jonathan Taylor then Seth McGowan, WR Laquon Treadwell etc. Defense and Special Teams also listed.

sources.label: nflverse-data releases — schedules, stats_player, stats_team
sources.what_confirmed: Release assets downloaded by CI run; per-file size and SHA-256 recorded in data/derived/manifest.json. Games.parquet carries closing spread_line, total_line, moneyline fields.

sources.label: nflreadr — Data Dictionary: Schedules (nflreadr)
sources.what_confirmed: Field definitions confirmed: result = home_score minus away_score (h_score - v_score); total = sum of team scores; away_rest/home_rest = days of rest; moneyline fields present. First 25 of 45 entries returned on 2026-11-02.

sources.label: DraftKings Massachusetts Sportsbook House Rules — active edition (approved 10.7.26)
sources.what_confirmed: Active edition status confirmed via MGC licensee page 2026-11-02; PDF lists push, parlay, SGP and teaser settlement rules. Previous 8.1.24 edition archived as obsolete.

sources.label: Massachusetts Gaming Commission — Archive of obsolete sports-wagering house rules
sources.what_confirmed: Page lists the 8.1.24 edition cited in earlier builds as Obsolete as of 8.18.15; active edition is 10.7.26.

sources.label: DraftKings Sportsbook Betting Rules (filed with MGC, 8.1.24 edition — now archived)
sources.what_confirmed: States spread bet is push if outcome tied once spread applied; total exactly equal to line is void; defines Parlay, SGP, Progressive Parlay and Teaser. Still resolves; flagged as edition-stale.

sources.label: DraftKings Support — What is a parlay bet? (all legs must win; push handling)
sources.what_confirmed: A parlay combines two or more single wagers; all must win; if one selection pushes it is removed and odds recalculated; correlated selections may be restricted. SGP types listed.

sources.label: DraftKings Support — What is a prop bet?
sources.what_confirmed: Prop bet = wager on individual player or specific in-game event, not directly connected to game outcome.

sources.label: DraftKings Support — Glossary of Betting Terms (ATS, spread, moneyline, over/under, teaser, push)
sources.what_confirmed: Defines point spread (+/- handicap, covers), ATS, over/unders, teaser (adjusted spreads/totals at lower payout), push handling in parlays, related contingencies (correlated picks restricted).

sources.label: Nevada Gaming Control Board — Regulation 22, Race Books and Sports Pools
sources.what_confirmed: Official definitions: sports pool accepts wagers on sporting events including parlay card wagers; parlay card wager = wager on 2+ games or 2+ contingencies within games; permitted wagers include professional sports sanctioned by league records; outcomes confirmable from official league records.

sources.label: Pinnacle — Bottom-Up Betting Explained: What is an Originator and How Do You Build a Basic Model?
sources.what_confirmed: Defines originator as someone who aims to originate own lines using raw data and own models; for NFL models lists inputs: player stats, team stats, injury reports, weather data for outdoor games.

sources.label: Pinnacle — What Is Closing Line Value (CLV) in Sports Betting?
sources.what_confirmed: CLV = how bet odds compare to final closing odds; positive CLV = better line than close and one of strongest indicators of skill/long-term profitability; tips: bet early, track injuries/weather, shop lines.

sources.label: Pinnacle — Betting odds explained: How do odds work? (probability ↔ odds; bookmaker margin)
sources.what_confirmed: 1/decimal odds = implied probability; amount by which implied probability diverges from 100% is margin bookmaker has added.

sources.label: Pinnacle — Implied probability odds-conversion guide (American odds formulas)
sources.what_confirmed: Worked American-odds examples: -520 → 520/620 = 83.89%; +381 → 100/481 = 20.79%; applying to -110: 110/210 = 52.38% implied per side.

sources.label: Pinnacle — The Kelly Criterion perspective
sources.what_confirmed: Kelly = staking where stake proportional to perceived edge; full Kelly variance can be uninvestably high, motivating fractional Kelly.

sources.label: Kelly (1956) — A New Interpretation of Information Rate, Bell System Technical Journal 35:4 pp 917-926
sources.publisher: J.L. Kelly Jr. / Internet Archive scan of BSTJ
sources.what_confirmed: Original 1956 paper deriving fraction of capital to bet to maximize exponential growth rate. Abstract matches 1956 paper.

sources.label: Benjamini & Hochberg (1995) — Controlling the False Discovery Rate, JRSS-B 57(1) 289-300
sources.what_confirmed: Full text PDF opened; procedure and FDR definition read from paper itself.

sources.label: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook 1.3.6.7.2 — Critical Values of Student's t Distribution
sources.what_confirmed: Table page opened and read (two-sided test instructions and critical values).

sources.label: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook 7.2.4 — one-proportion test (binomial z = (p̂-p0)/sqrt(p0(1-p0)/N))
sources.what_confirmed: Used for skill vs luck gate: test whether win rate exceeds break-even implied by price. Valid N>30, min{Np0,N(1-p0)} ≥5.

sources.label: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook — CORRELATION: Pearson r formula r=Sxy/sqrt(Sxx·Syy)
sources.what_confirmed: Formula and p-value test for correlation, range -1..+1, significance via F(1,N-2).

sources.label: Kaggle official docs — Competitions: public vs private leaderboard, overfitting warning
sources.what_confirmed: Public leaderboard visible during competition, based on sample of test data; Private leaderboard final ranking on remainder; overfitting: high public score doesn't guarantee high private score.

sources.label: Kaggle — NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 (hosted by NFL; $100,000 prize pool)
sources.what_confirmed: Real example of leaderboard competition with cash rewards run by NFL itself using Next Gen Stats data; $45,000 open track at earlier read, now $100,000 total pool; judges are analytics staff of 32 NFL clubs.

sources.label: NFL Media — National Football League Announces Seventh Annual Big Data Bowl Powered by AWS
sources.what_confirmed: Confirms NFL runs analytics leaderboard competitions on Kaggle with six-figure prize money ($100,000 in prizes on Kaggle, judged by NFL team data analysts).

sources.label: NOAA National Weather Service — official point forecasts (forecast.weather.gov)
sources.what_confirmed: Point forecast verified 2026-11-01 (7-day forecast for lat/lon point including hourly). Use stadium lat/lon for outdoor-game weather inputs. Historical note: ~57% weather coverage for outdoor games 2020-2026.

sources.label: NFL.com — official team statistics (offense/defense/special teams)
sources.what_confirmed: Official team offense/defense stats page; 2026 REG offense passing team stats confirmed live.

sources.label: NFL.com — official player statistics hub
sources.what_confirmed: Official player stats hub covering passing, rushing, receiving seasons back to 1920; verified live.
